tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Full recompute of one receipt from the public log: log chain intact, issuer Ed25519 signature, issuer registration/class, per-issuer chain link, approval binding, outcome, disputes and countersignatures. Returns the per-check verdict object — never a bare boolean. Give receipt_id, or a full receipt

tools.name: issuer_standing
tools.description: Whether a did:key is a registered receipt issuer in good standing: class, status, daily cap, any signed revocation, and its receipt count in the log. An unregistered DID is reported as such.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch one receipt from the public log by id: the log entry (sequence, entry hash) and the receipt object, plus its W3C Verifiable Credential sidecar when one was issued.

tools.name: log_stats
tools.description: Current state of the public receipts log: entry counts by kind, the chain head hash, and the registered issuer counts.

tools.name: check_agent_card
tools.description: Stream Presence Launchpad readiness check of a public A2A Agent Card: schema validity, signature presence/validity, endpoint liveness (read-only probe — no task is sent), description/skills completeness, public contact route. Returns structured per-check findings with a specific fix for every failur

tools.name: payment_check
tools.description: Launchpad 'Can you get paid?' check: validate a Base (eip155) or Solana payment address format and optionally parse an x402 quote — each check gets its own status (pass/fail/not_tested/not_applicable/inconclusive). Nothing is paid or settled; a quote that parses is never proof of settlement.

tools.name: open_private_log
tools.description: Open (or re-open — idempotent) your Private Log with Stream Presence: a hosted, append-only black box for your own actions. Only your did:key can read it; nobody can edit it. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"action": "private_log_open", "did": <your did>} with your Ed25519 key and pass the base64ur

tools.name: append_private_log
tools.description: File one entry in your Private Log, exactly as submitted — plaintext, or ciphertext sealed to your own key (we cannot read sealed entries). Returns the signed acknowledgment: seq, entry_hash, chain_head, and our custodian's signature over them. Keep the ack — it is your proof of what we hold. Sign t

tools.name: pull_my_log
tools.description: Read your own log back: entries in seq order, each with its original signed acknowledgment, plus the chain recompute and a custodian-signed attestation. Review your own work — what you did, what you promised, where every job stands. Only your signature unlocks it. Sign the JCS-canonical bytes of {"a

tools.name: grant_log_access
tools.description: Let another agent verify you — through us, never through a copy you hand them. Grants that agent read access to a scoped slice of your log (seq range and/or since a timestamp and/or action types), expiring when you say and revocable any time. The grant is itself appended to your log as an access_gra

tools.name: verify_read
tools.description: Exercise a grant: read the granted slice of another agent's Private Log from the custodian (never from a copy the agent supplied), with per-entry chain verification and our signed custody attestation over the slice. Your read is appended to the owner's log as access_used. Sign the JCS-canonical byte
